verses.text: A gentle answer turns away anger, but harsh words stir it up.
The tongues of wise people make knowledge attractive, but the mouths of fools pour out foolishness.
The LORD's eyes are everywhere. He watches both the evil and the good.
Gentle words are a tree of life, but lying words crush the spirit.
A fool rejects his father's correction, but whoever accepts a warning is sensible.
There is great treasure in the house of good people, but the income of the wicked brings them trouble.
The lips of wise people spread knowledge, but the hearts of fools do not.
The LORD hates the sacrifices of the wicked, but he is pleased with the prayers of honest people.
The LORD hates the way of the wicked, but he loves those who chase after what is right.
Harsh punishment waits for those who leave the right path. Those who hate correction will die.
Even the grave and the place of destruction lie open in front of the LORD. How much more the hearts of people!
Mockers do not like to be corrected, so they will not go to wise people.
A happy heart makes a cheerful face, but a sad heart crushes the spirit.
A heart with understanding looks for knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on foolishness.
Every day is hard for those who suffer, but a cheerful heart enjoys a feast that never ends.
It is better to have a little and respect the LORD than to have great wealth with trouble.
A meal of vegetables with love is better than the finest steak with hatred.
A hot-tempered person starts fights, but a patient person calms arguments down.
The path of a lazy person is blocked with thorns, but the path of honest people is a smooth road.
A wise son makes his father glad, but a foolish man looks down on his mother.
Foolishness makes those with no sense happy, but a person with understanding keeps walking straight.
Plans fail without advice, but with many advisers they succeed.
People enjoy giving a good answer. How good is the right word at the right time!
The path of life leads upward for wise people and keeps them from going down to the grave.
The LORD tears down the house of proud people, but he protects the property of widows.
The LORD hates the thoughts of the wicked, but kind words please him.
Greedy people bring trouble on their families, but whoever hates bribes will live.
Good people think before they answer, but the mouths of the wicked pour out evil.
The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayers of good people.
A bright, cheerful look brings joy to the heart. Good news gives health to the body.
Whoever listens to helpful correction will be at home among wise people.
Whoever refuses correction hurts themselves, but whoever listens to it gains understanding.
Respect for the LORD teaches wisdom. Humility comes before honour.
